mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicates housing sector contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has increased over the prior quarter, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 600.0 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence that drives immediate equity market gains, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 600.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market tightness that accelerates wage growth and triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annually), a deceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 2.5% annually) signals economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate < 2.5% annually during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
